CodeBehindForm
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = True
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = True
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Option Compare Database

Private Sub Detalle_Format(Cancel As Integer, FormatCount As Integer)
TotTipo = TotTipo + TotCancel
End Sub



Private Sub EncabezadoDelGrupo0_Print(Cancel As Integer, PrintCount As Integer)
TotTipo = 0
End Sub

Private Sub EncabezadoDelInforme_Print(Cancel As Integer, PrintCount As Integer)
Total = 0
End Sub

Private Sub PieDelGrupo0_Print(Cancel As Integer, PrintCount As Integer)
Total = Total + SubTotal
End Sub

Private Sub Report_Load()
If Forms!MenuContabilidad!Fecha1 = Forms!MenuContabilidad!Fecha2 Then
    Dia.Visible = True
    Etiqueta52.Visible = False
    Else
    EntreFechas.Visible = True
End If
End Sub
